seo_title: A+ Construction Case Study: ADU Ad Messaging | SOMIN
description: SOMIN read ADU builder ads for A+ Construction from March 2024 to February 2025, found its B2B voice heavily underrepresented and wrote 6 key messages to test.
eyebrow: Brand case study · ADU construction · Sacramento
h1: A+ Construction's ADU ads speak to homeowners, leaving B2B as a moonshot
lede: SOMIN read the paid ads of Sacramento ADU (accessory dwelling unit) builder A+ Construction and its rivals. Most propositions target B2C homeowners; B2B buyers are heavily underrepresented. SOMIN wrote six key messages to test.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · March 2024 – February 2025 · Sacramento · B2C homeowners

challenge.title: A+ Construction's paid ads against rival ADU builders
challenge.body: A+ Construction ADU Builders needed to know which audiences the ADU category targets and which tensions to own.

approach.title: From SoMonitor personas to ads in three styles
points: SOMIN SoMonitor read A+ Construction's and rivals' paid ads.
Mapped B2C and B2B personas and tension themes.
SOMONITOR AI turned persona–tension pairs into stories and insights.
Insights became key messages, three ads each, in classic copywriting styles.
Each message got ad visuals and ZMOT notes.

findings_title: B2C propositions dominate, and A+ Construction lags on B2B

findings.title: Most propositions address B2C homeowners
findings.body: The largest tension theme is Addressing the Lack of Affordable Housing and Utilizing Underutilized Backyards.

findings.title: A+ Construction is heavily underrepresented in B2B
findings.body: SOMIN flags the B2B personas, Ambitious Business Builder and Ambitious Entrepreneur, as a moonshot.

findings.title: Both B2C personas share the same three tensions
findings.body: Creative Home Maker and Home Decor Enthusiast: renovation challenges, affordable housing and underused backyards, and affordable construction.

delivered.title: Six key messages for Sacramento homeowners, three ads each
points: Four SOMIN personas, two B2C and two B2B
Four tension themes, from home renovation to business growth
Six key messages, such as 'Your Dream Home, Without the Stress' and 'Build Smart. Live Secure.'
Visual ad expressions and ZMOT notes

quote.text: When it comes to addressing B2B customers we are heavily underrepresented

outcome.title: A+ Construction should win homeowners first, then B2B
outcome.body: The ads answer a homeowner's ADU questions on cost, value and ease, leading with pre-approved plans, turnkey service and a free virtual consultation. B2B stays a moonshot.

faq.a: JC Construction & Remodeling, Design Build Specialists, Cottage, Hex General Contractors, G.J. Gardner Homes United States, NONNA HOMES and Golden ADU.
The Zero Moment of Truth: the research before a decision. The ads meet homeowners there with clear benefits and a free consultation.
It is heavily underrepresented with B2B personas, who face tensions such as growing a business and sourcing skilled labour, so the briefing leaves B2B for later.
